activity_summary: At Uxbridge the first of the morning had been stiff, and you were walking. The corn was in. Women were gleaning, and they did not look up, and they did not speak. You did not ask for the spare. You left the field to its own work.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked through the stiffness, and left the gleaners to the field.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Refused the spare, and kept the pace.

entities.name: the spare nag
entities.context: Mentioned in They do not look up

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: They are gleaning, and they do not look up.
